summary: Logic Artists' historical tactical RPG series, moving from Spanish expeditions in the Americas to Viking Britain and late-Republic Rome.

entries.title: Expeditions: Conquistador

emulation.notes: Use native PC rather than the Windows Phone route.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the complete tactical RPG route with the best capture/display flexibility; Linux, OS X, and Windows Phone have no documented content advantage.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release through Steam/GOG or another current PC storefront, applying compatibility tweaks if needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or platform-exclusive story edition is documented.

entries.title: Expeditions: Viking

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or platform-exclusive story edition is documented.
